name: algoneo
description: AlgoNeo Automated Options Trading & Backtesting Terminal

scripts.restart: sudo systemctl restart algo.service 2>/dev/null || pm2 restart algoneo
scripts.status: sudo systemctl status algo.service 2>/dev/null || pm2 status
scripts.logs: sudo journalctl -u algo.service -f -n 50 2>/dev/null || pm2 logs algoneo
scripts.setup: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup:linux: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix web install
